steps: Join the free Panel Pro database at uriux.com/participate and complete profile surveys
Receive study invitations matched to your profile (in-person, remote, or client-site)
Reply to the confirmation email, state your preferred gratuity method, and sign the NDA
Attend the session on time (arrive 15 minutes early for in-person; 5 for online)
Receive your gratuity within 5–7 business days via an emailed redemption link with multiple payout options
timing: Gratuity received within 5–7 business days after study completion via an emailed redemption link; choose from multiple payment options.
who_pays: User Research International (URI) pays you the gratuity — you get an emailed redemption link after each study and choose from multiple payment options.
who_qualifies: Panel Pro members, invited per study based on your profile; photo ID is required at in-person sessions, and only one account per person is allowed. In-person sessions are concentrated at URI's labs in Redmond, WA (plus occasional client sites); remote studies exist and URI says most can be completed from home.
work_available: Not guaranteed. Invitations depend on your profile matching a study's needs, and applying never guarantees an invite. URI says new studies are added daily, but your share is unpredictable — stack URI with other research panels so a slow week on one is covered by another.
what_gets_accepted: A study counts when you confirm your invite, sign the NDA, and complete the full session. Arriving late can reduce your gratuity and hurt eligibility for future studies, and multiple accounts mean disqualification plus nonpayment.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Joining Panel Pro is free. Your unpaid time: completing profile surveys before invites arrive, and travel to Redmond, WA if you take in-person sessions (parking/commute are on you). Sessions themselves run 60-90 minutes and are paid.
when_cash_arrives: Within 5-7 business days after your session ends. URI emails you a gratuity redemption link, and you choose from multiple payment options when you redeem it.
